title: Sashastra Seema Bal SSB Constable HC ASI SI PET PST Exam Date 2026
postName: Constable / Head Constable / ASI / SI – PET & PST
vacancyDetails: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) exam date notice for SSB Constable, HC, ASI and SI posts
qualification: As per post-wise SSB recruitment notification (Constable / HC / ASI / SI)
selectionProcess: Written / CBT (as applicable) → PET → PST → Medical → Document Verification → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Admit card / call letter for PET-PST; original photo ID; sports shoes and required kit as per notice
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssbrectt.gov.in or ssb.gov.in recruitment section
2. Open PET / PST Exam Date notice for Constable / HC / ASI / SI

shortDescription: SSB Constable, HC, ASI & SI PET/PST Exam Date 2026 out. Check schedule on ssbrectt.gov.in.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the PET / PST Exam Date 2026 notice covering Constable, Head Constable, ASI and SI recruitment stages.

Candidates shortlisted for physical tests should download the official call letter, check venue and date, and prepare as per height, chest, race and other standards mentioned in the advertisement.

Physical stages

  • PST: Height, chest and other physical standards
  • PET: Race / physical efficiency events as notified

Always rely on ssbrectt.gov.in for authentic dates and call letters.
